resources.string: After the wake word it opens the Claude app and turns on voice mode. After the call it reads the last answer so it stays on the display. It sends nothing anywhere.
Without the microphone this won\'t work. Allow it in the app settings.
The Claude app is not installed.
The accessibility service is off, turn on voice mode in Claude yourself. Turn the service on with a long press.
The accessibility service is on but not running. Long press, turn it off and on again.
Trial: not opening Claude, just flashing.
Connector offline: Claude can\'t control volume, printing or scanning right now.
Voice mode did not start last time. Open Claude and check what it shows.
Ask: “%1$s” and your question.\nEnd: “%1$s, end the meeting”.
Say “%1$s” and ask out loud. The last answer stays here in writing.
How long do I boil a hard-boiled egg?
About 9 to 10 minutes from when the water starts to boil. Then put it straight into cold water, it peels more easily and the yolk doesn\'t turn green.
Tap to start recording, a minute and a half. Each time the edges flash green, say “%1$s” once.
Could not open the microphone, recording is not running.
The speech model did not load, cannot evaluate the recording.
Done, thanks. The phone recognized “%1$s” %2$d× out of 10 in the recording, and triggered %3$d× during normal talk.
Stand close. When the edges flash green, say “%1$s” once.
Stay quiet and wait until it flashes again.
Now walk 2 to 3 metres away, to where you would speak from the sofa or desk. Wait there for the flash.
Done. Now talk normally for half a minute, about anything except Claude.
The speech model did not load: %1$s
The microphone dropped out, trying again.
Every call in a new conversation
Off: continues the last conversation and opens a bit faster.
For a black bezel. Light suits a white one.
For Claude\'s settings or signing in. Back to the clock with the Home button.
Or “%1$s, record the meeting” and at the end “%1$s, end the meeting”.
The clock instead of a custom screen, and settings as at the start.
Restore the clock and default settings? The custom screen will be deleted.
